reference_role: Original catalog sprites inspected as style and scale references, not copied as mod artwork

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HD sprite for equipment shop/inventory in 1990s military science-fiction vertical shooter. Input image is an ORIGINAL STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Generate a distinct Ion Lance: compact single long railgun barrel pointing exactly UP from an armored gray rectangular gun pod, two subtle electric-blue induction rails, red service panel. Top-down orthographic overhead view, precise thin symmetrical military silhouette. Isolated single object centered on genuinely transparent 1024x1024 square canvas, silhouette central 70% with12% transparentmargin. Match reference muted gunmetal, chunky readability, upper-left highlight. Restrained panel/machined detail forHD. No text, labels, outside glow/shadows, frame, border, extraobjects. Displaylogical16x16SDand64x64HD, so silhouette must survive reduction.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated ion beam pulse projectile sprite for a military science-fiction vertical shooter. Original input is STYLE reference only for readable chunky projectile palette. Generate a straight very narrow vertical electric blue/white ion lance beam traveling exactly UP: continuous thin pale core, bounded cobalt/cyan stepped edges, brightest pointed upper tip, slightly tapered bottom tail. No gun, no spacecraft, no extraneous light halo. Orthographic view, perfectly straight, centered, width:height1:8. Genuine transparent square canvas with generous sides and15%transparent top/bottom margin. Pixel-inspired military science-fiction HD detail, minimal colors, reference's crispbounded silhouette. No text, labels, shadows, frame, multiple objects. Intendedlogicalcanvas4x32 and16x128HD.

conversion: prepare_art.rs crops to alpha>=128 silhouette, fits with transparent margins, preserves aspect and reduces to logical SD/4xHD. SD nearest sampling alpha128; HD Lanczos3 alpha64. Pixel values quantized at runtime.
